headline: Drones hit a major Yandex data centre in Russia and forced the company to suspend operations there.
score_reason: Pool score 8 kept: a major AI company's data centre is offline after an attack; the company confirms it, and the attacker is not named.
importance_line: It matters to customers of Yandex Cloud in the affected zone and to the safety of data centres in the war, but the report does not say who launched the drones.
summary: Reuters reports, as carried by NBC News, that drones hit a major data centre owned by Yandex, Russia's leading AI and technology company, in the Ryazan region, causing a fire and forcing it to suspend operations. Yandex said its core consumer services were not affected, and it advised Yandex Cloud customers to use other zones after a power problem in one zone.
notes: Reuters original blocked here (HTTP 401); text read on NBC News, which carries the Reuters report, so Reuters is the source. Score 8 kept. The text does not say who launched the drones; the entry names no party. Machine action true: drones flew and struck the site.
